name: assembly
description: Read, write and debug x86-64/ARM assembly: registers, calling conventions, memory, syscalls. Use for .s/.asm files and low-level debugging. Detect the assembler/objdump first.

name: fortran
description: Write and compile Fortran (77/90+) for numerical/HPC code: arrays, modules, intrinsics. Use for .f90/.f files. Detect gfortran first.

name: cobol
description: Read and maintain COBOL business/legacy code: divisions, PIC clauses, records, files. Use for .cob/.cbl files. Detect cobc (GnuCOBOL) first.

name: ada
description: Write and build Ada/SPARK for safety-critical code: strong typing, contracts, tasking. Use for .adb/.ads files. Detect gnat first.

name: prolog
description: Write logic programs in Prolog: facts, rules, unification, backtracking, cut. Use for .pl Prolog files. Detect swipl first.
checklist: Cut used deliberately, not to hide bugs

name: tcl
description: Write Tcl scripts (and Tk/Expect): everything-is-a-string, lists, procs. Use for .tcl files. Detect tclsh first.
checklist: Braces vs quotes for grouping understood

name: crystal
description: Write Crystal, a Ruby-like statically typed compiled language. Use for .cr files and shard.yml. Detect crystal first.
checklist: Types annotated where inference is unclear

name: vala
description: Write Vala (compiles to C via GObject) for GNOME/GTK apps. Use for .vala files. Detect valac first.

name: solidity
description: Write and audit Solidity smart contracts with a strong security focus: reentrancy, overflow, access control, gas. Use for .sol files. Detect solc/foundry/hardhat first.

name: verilog-vhdl
description: Write and simulate hardware description in Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL: modules, clocking, testbenches. Use for .v/.sv/.vhd files. Detect iverilog/ghdl first.
commands: iverilog -o sim design.v tb.v && vvp sim

name: gdscript
description: Write GDScript for Godot game logic: nodes, signals, scenes, the game loop. Use for .gd files. Detect the godot binary first.
checklist: Work off the frame path where heavy

name: hcl-lang
description: Write HCL for Terraform/Packer/Nomad: blocks, expressions, variables, functions. Use for .hcl/.tf files. Detect terraform/packer first.

name: protobuf-lang
description: Define Protocol Buffers schemas: messages, fields, evolution rules, codegen. Use for .proto files. Detect protoc/buf first.

name: graphql-lang
description: Design GraphQL schemas (SDL): types, queries, mutations, subscriptions, evolution. Use for .graphql/.gql schema files.
pitfalls: Overly nested types enabling deep queries

name: raku
description: Write Raku (Perl 6): grammars, junctions, gradual typing, concurrency. Use for .raku/.rakumod files. Detect raku first.
checklist: Gradual typing used where it helps
Grammars for parsing over regex hacks
pitfalls: Overusing operators to the point of obscurity

name: v-lang
description: Write V, a simple compiled language with fast builds and memory safety options. Use for .v files. Detect the v binary first.

name: odin
description: Write Odin, a systems language for data-oriented and game programming. Use for .odin files. Detect the odin binary first.

name: apl
description: Read and write array languages (APL/J/K/BQN): array-oriented, tacit, terse operators. Use for array-language sources. Detect the interpreter (dyalog/j/ngn-k) first.
